ctx.set-numbering-value.note: L2D-03: ctx set-numbering-value — right-click in a list selection, SetNumberingValue opens the numbering-value dialog (openNumberingValueDialog, editor.js currentListItem guard satisfied by the fixture)

ctx.adjust-list-indents.note: L2D-03: ctx adjust-list-indents — right-click in a list selection, AdjustListIndents opens the list-indents dialog (openListIndentsDialog, left/hanging fields wired to applyListIndents)

ctx.start-new-list.note: L2D-03: ctx start-new-list — handler emits insertUnorderedList (toggleList -> native execCommand), which converts the selected ol item(s) into a <ul> inside #editor

ctx.continue-numbering.note: L2D-03: continueNumbering() merges the caret <ol> into a PRECEDING <ol> sibling; the ctx-menu-in-list fixture builds a single <ol>, so the op is a no-op (Status.NoPreviousList) — pre cannot build the required two-adjacent-lists state
